explanation:
Repair only restage at the acknowledged frame-396 pose. The completed raise and transfer, differential retention, corrected inner opening and retired stalled target are preserved. The missing evidence is local separation from the neighboring bottle, not another rim fit or a global obstacle-height certificate.

Use the remaining observation allowance for different cross-camera bottle-surface measurements and a visible local silhouette support. Test a conservative carton/finger-opening/withdrawal envelope against a camera-ray separating plane, with the original 3.5 mm margin and explicit uncertainty allowances. The supporting boundary must cover the relevant band; sparse surface samples, hidden boundaries and artificial crop edges cannot establish clearance. Failed depths have at most two different spare pixels per view.

This revision intentionally issues no physical commands: no independently supported viewpoint-change route currently exists, and the required material transfer has already occurred. It can finish restage if the new local evidence supports the achieved approach; otherwise it returns the exact measurement gap without reopening, retrying residual corrections, weakening margins, or spending another review on unchanged evidence.
interface:
Complete executable Python main(api), using only api, np, math and geo and permitted builtins. Returns stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. At most one declared-schema api.review, four alternate api.point measurements, zero Jev calls and zero native steps. Control-slice boundaries therefore require no yield.

Reads and overwrites only restage.reference and restage.progress because all checkpoint slots are occupied. The reference checkpoint retains source metadata, rigid dimensions, landmark identities, frame-324 differential baseline and validated frame-396 models, plus new local samples, calibration and the conservative envelope. Progress preserves useful acknowledged actions, retired target, retention, actual states, failed relations and local separation tests. A pending action is preserved and never replayed. Handoff is compact and contains no future control code.

Geometry is reused only when its measurement frame and the acknowledged actual-state frame equal the current physical frame and models_stale is false. Every returned point is checked for dictionary membership, measurement_errors, camera, frame and finite coordinates before geometry. Review interpretations are not independent sensors. Only a current, complete local boundary witness can support a separation plane; no hidden clearance is inferred from sample extrema. Changed identity or observed contact returns needs_replan; missing evidence or a failed local margin returns blocked; a review stop returns abort. Stage completion requires the new external-separation evidence plus measured object-to-hand retention, material carton displacement, unchanged fit and above-rim reserves.
jev_protocol:
This is an observation-only repair of an already moved approach, so it makes zero api.control/api.drive/api.choose calls. Jev is not asked to calculate geometry, inspect images, invent contact evidence or authorize release. There are no unused control stubs or future-stage actions.

The current stage's seven control-question meanings remain explicitly defined: x, y and z refer to state.processed_features.axes.x/y/z.goal_relation and world translation; rx, ry and rz refer to the corresponding world rotation-vector component. Each has exactly negative=decrease, hold=within_tolerance, positive=increase. The gripper question refers to state.processed_features.objective.gripper and has open=explicitly requested opening, close=continued closure, keep=preserve the previous command. No such question is invoked in this revision because no new physical action is justified. The actual closed command is checked, not reissued or treated as retention evidence.

Numerical stage features are the actual frame and hand state, attachment error and allowance, face-normal agreement, observed carton displacement, fit margin, carton and expanded-finger rim reserves, uncertainty-padded envelope, cross-camera sample validity and each tested local separating-plane gap. geo.attachment_error compares corresponding carton landmarks against the measured whole-transfer hand transform. Normal agreement supplements the two landmarks. Feature distinctness is assessed relative to the working depth floor, not a universal object-size threshold.

The original 1.5 mm position tolerance, 0.015 rad rotation tolerance and 3.5 mm fit margin remain in the acceptance calculation; they are not claims of achieved controller accuracy. Finger geometry includes the prospective 20 mm outward excursion per tool-y side, 20 mm world-up withdrawal, a 4 mm geometry allowance and pose-tolerance padding. Candidate silhouette planes include a two-pixel contour allowance and a 0.5 mm working measurement floor. A local silhouette must bound the relevant bottle side throughout the assembly's projected tangential band; artificial cropping, partial silhouettes or a few exposed depths do not qualify. This is a bounded operational check, not a full-scene reconstruction or collision certificate.

Stopping is finite: one fresh cross-camera review, at most four different replacement depth samples, bounded polygon tests, then return. No stalled physical target can be repeated. Fresh local evidence can establish the effect of the already acknowledged transfer without more movement; otherwise measurements and the exact unsupported relation are checkpointed for supervision. Only the outer supervisor may propose whole-task completion.
